main.description: Get the authenticated user's payment profile. Returns defaults when no profile is configured. `acceptingPayments` on the profile view reflects server-derived readiness from the user's broker list. When called against a broker, the response also includes a `broker` block with the broker DID, this user's account status with that broker, and a fresh onboarding link.

profile.description: The profile view (defaults applied when no profile record exists).

hasProfile.description: Whether the user has saved a profile record.

broker.description: Present only when the responder is a broker. Carries the broker DID, the authed user's account status with this broker, and an onboarding link the client can redirect to.

brokerView.description: Broker-side view of the authed user's account. Returned only when `recipient.profile.get` is called on a broker (rather than a PoS).

did.description: DID of the broker answering the request.

status.description: Broker-defined onboarding state for the authed user. `ready` means the user can receive payouts; the other values indicate where onboarding is and whether action is needed.

onboardingUrl.description: Optional. Fresh broker-hosted onboarding link. Clients should redirect the user here to complete (or update) their account.
